The '''Second Herglic Feud''' took place in [[9757 BBY]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> and shared its name with the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Species/Legends|species]], whose [[Herglic Trade Empire|trade empire]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[13,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The conflict saw the participation of the Republic's [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit]]. The rocket-jumpers fought bravely during the event,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which became known as one of the unit's legendary exploits.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Second Herglic Feud was introduced in a section of the [[2009]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]''<ref name="GaW" /> authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Blogspot">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/09/endnotes-for-galaxy-at-war.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Galaxy at War}}</ref> A mention of the conflict was originally meant to be included in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the Wallace-authored section that would have contained the mention was cut before the book's release. That section was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various content cut from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
